name: Beccaccino
summary: Four-player partnership trick-taking game derived from Tressette with a trump suit chosen each hand.
rules_text: Played anti-clockwise with 40 Italian cards ranking 3,2,A,K,Horse,J,7,6,5,4. Teams sit opposite. Each hand 10 cards dealt in 2x5. Battezzante chooses trump: first hand holder of 4 of coins, then player to dealer's right, who then deals next. Partner of battezzante cannot look before trump is named. Battezzante leads first trick. Follow suit if able; otherwise may trump or discard. Highest of led suit wins unless trumped, highest trump wins. Winner leads next. Holding Ace,2,3 of trump can declare marafona during first trick for 3 points. When leading you may announce Busso (partner play highest and return suit), Volo (no more of led suit), Striscio (have low cards of led suit). Card values: Ace=1, 3/2/K/Horse/J=1/3, plus 1 for last trick, fractions dropped making 11 points per hand. First team to 41 claims at any time without reviewing old tricks; correct claim wins, wrong claim loses.
